programme.desc: S1 E6 — Classic Comebacks Mary unleashes some of her classic favourites that have moved in and out of fashion, but still have a much-loved stronghold. Her take on a classic prawn cocktail, a warming deep rich onion soup and a divine banoffee pie are too enticing not to try out at home. Mary also prepares a leek and onion quiche to add to her ploughman's lunch and who better to eat it with than traditional farmer, Robert Sampson.
programme.title: Classic Mary Berry

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Delicious Memories Mary travels to Scotland to enjoy the best of their everyday larder with recipes inspired by her own Scots heritage. She discovers wonderful shellfish in Ullapool, and shares the joy of venison cooked on a BBQ with chef Tom Kitchin.
programme.title: Mary Berry Everyday

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Hearty and Wholesome Mary shares inspiring everyday dishes full of wholesome goodness from her secret tip for a rich bolognese to a heartwarming soup. She dons a white suit and tries her hand at beekeeping, collecting fresh honey to make a winning pud.
programme.title: Mary Berry Everyday

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Big Crowd Pleasers Mary opens her garden to host a village fête and shares her brilliant flair for turning easy dishes into spectacular crowd pleasers. She's visited by two passionate brothers for a lesson in the secrets of authentic Italian pizza making.
programme.title: Mary Berry Everyday

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Naughty but Nice This is indulgence at its best with Mary's mouthwatering dishes that give the everyday a lift with lashings of naughtiness. Treats are in store as Mary pursues the history of the great British pie, and tempts us with the secret to an easy sticky toffee pud.
programme.title: Mary Berry Everyday

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Feeding the Family Mary shares some inspirational ideas to make everyday family meals exciting with fabulous no-fuss dishes. She tries her hand at milking a goat, and shows her granddaughter how to make her own goat's cheese for a family picnic.
programme.title: Mary Berry Everyday

programme.desc: S1 E6 — When You Want to Show Off As Mary and her husband reach their 50th wedding anniversary, it's time to push the boat out. Mary shares her secrets to surprisingly easy showstoppers, recreates canapés from the 1960s and finishes the series with sparkle.
programme.title: Mary Berry Everyday

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Special Days Mary cooks up a celebration of five delicious dishes suitable for those special days, when one have people around for dinner or simply want to treat a loved one at home.
programme.title: Mary Berry's Foolproof Cooking

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Comfort Days Mary prepares a warming roasted butternut squash soup with indulgent cheese and Parma ham twists, a foolproof mackerel pate with lime that could not be simpler, followed by a Mexican tortilla bake, and more.
programme.title: Mary Berry's Foolproof Cooking

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Episode 4 Jamie makes a deliciously creamy red pepper pasta dish and bread sauce tray bake. He also showcases a big beef brisket and a bean dish. Jamie then wraps it all up with a foolproof pastry, as he rustles up a fantastic free-form strawberry tart.
programme.title: Jamie: Fast and Simple

programme.desc: S2 E11 — Off the Hook Specials Guy enjoys crazy plates from all over the States as he tries some one-of-a-kind specials. In Kansas City he tries tater tot pizza, he has brunch in California and in Michigan he eats Vietnamese.

programme.desc: S7 E1 — Cake Week The competition begins with cake week. The group first take on a British classic and are then faced with Mary's technical challenge - a popular little cake with a fatless sponge and tricky chocolate work. Finally, the bakers have the opportunity to show the judges what they can do with their showstopper.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S7 E2 — Biscuit Week It's week two of 'The Great British Bake Off', and it is crunch time as Paul and Mary set the bakers three biscuit challenges. The bakers start with a signature challenge, but who will snap first with just a few hours to make 24 identical decorated biscuits? Hidden under the gingham cloth is a technical challenge that requires perfect piping to avoid a crumbling whirl.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S6 E3 — Bread It's bread week in the tent and the bakers must create quick breads for the signature challenge. The technical challenge is baguettes and for the showstopper, the bakers must make edible 3D bread sculptures.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S7 E4 — Batter Week It's week four and just nine bakers remain, and for the very first time it's batter week! Mary and Paul have set three challenges to test the bakers on some store cupboard classics. To kick-start, a British favourite, it may sound simple, but the judges are looking for perfection. A uniform bake across the batch, and topped with a tasty savoury filling, the bakers really have to rise to the occasion in this signature challenge.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S7 E5 — Pastry Week It is pastry week, and with just eight bakers left, Mary and Paul are looking for perfection. They have set three challenges to test the bakers on three very different types of pastry. For the signature challenge it is breakfast time, Danish style.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.desc: S7 E6 — Botanical Week It's week six of 'The Great British Bake Off' and just seven bakers remain. This week, for the very first time on Bake Off, it's botanical week. There are three challenges inspired by nature. The bakers can reach for anything that grows to give their bakes maximum botanical taste.
programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

The catch is that Bean is no art expert and his trip was a ploy by his British employers to get rid of him. Unfortunately, no one has warned the Americans about Mr Bean.
programme.title: Bean: The Ultimate Disaster Movie

programme.desc: Mr Bean is going on holiday to the south of France, looking for a quiet and sunny trip in the Riviera. However, his trip doesn't go as smoothly as he expected when he has to face a series of misunderstandings and totally unfortunate coincidences. Eventually, Mr Bean will end up spoiling the last film of the snobbish director Carson Clay and appearing by accident at the Cannes Film Festival.
programme.title: Mr Bean's Holiday

programme.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.
programme.title: Peter Rabbit

programme.desc: Despite his efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his reputation for mischief among the other rabbits. Once he adventures out of the garden Peter finds himself in a world where mischief is appreciated, but soon his family come to bring him home.
programme.title: Peter Rabbit 2

programme.desc: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.
programme.title: The Borrowers

programme.desc: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.
programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends

programme.desc: Creepy fairy tale following the fortunes of a young orphan who becomes embroiled in a supernatural adventure. Brought up on his kindly grandmother's scary stories about witches, he stumbles on a real coven while on holiday. Overhearing their plans to capture all the children in Britain, he sets out to stop them, remaining undeterred throughout - even when he has been turned into a mouse.
programme.title: The Witches

programme.desc: Music and lights bring magic to life. From `Sing' to `The Bad Guys 2', enjoy animated animal adventures the whole family will love.
programme.title: The Cinema List: Animal Antics

programme.desc: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.
programme.title: Babe

programme.desc: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.
programme.title: Yogi Bear

programme.desc: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.
programme.title: A Minecraft Movie

programme.desc: Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.
programme.title: Wicked: For Good

programme.desc: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.
programme.title: Look Who's Talking

programme.desc: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.
programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too

programme.desc: In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.
programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now

programme.desc: When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.
programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island

programme.desc: Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.
programme.title: Jumanji

programme.desc: Old rivalries and new adversaries await Daniel and Mr Miyagi as they travel to Okinawa to visit Miyagi's ailing father.
programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II

programme.desc: A boy trained in the martial arts is alienated from his mentor just when he needs to prepare for a showdown with his arch-enemy. Instead, he turns to a Vietnam vet who teaches him how to fight dirty - a strategy the youth comes to realise is a mistake.
programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III

programme.desc: In a desolate near future, vicious motorcycle gangs roam the wastelands attacking what is left of civilisation. With law and order in chaos, a tough police patrolman enforces a new kind of law - cold-blooded revenge - when his family is murdered by one of the gangs.
programme.title: Mad Max

programme.desc: Fast-paced apocalyptic adventure. In a hostile post-World War III world, petrol is the most precious commodity and people will do anything to get it. Embittered lone warrior Max agrees to help when an oil-producing community comes under attack from a violent gang determined to get its hands on their fuel.
programme.title: Mad Max 2: The Road Warrior

programme.desc: Set in a lawless, post-apocalyptic wilderness. To retrieve his camel train, hero Max enters the seedy, savage, rough-hewn precincts of Bartertown. Forced to fight for his possessions, he breaks the only rule of the city and is banished. In the desert, he is rescued by a tribe of feral children who see him as a prophesied saviour.
programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome

programme.desc: A kidnapped family and their two murderous captors confront bloodthirsty demons after crossing the Mexican border.
programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn

programme.desc: A bank robber headed for a Mexican heist stumbles into a bar frequented by the undead, where he's turned into a vampire.
programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money

programme.desc: The Enterprise crew falls under the spell of Spock's half-brother, a renegade Vulcan on an obsessive quest to find God.
programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier

programme.desc: The Klingon Empire is falling apart, and they want peace with the Federation. However, when an unprotected Klingon craft is fired on, Kirk and Dr McCoy are placed on trial for murder.
programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country

programme.desc: The maiden voyage of the third Starship Enterprise is jeopardised by mad scientist Soran. Only one man knows how to stop the boffin, but he's been dead 78 years.
programme.title: Star Trek Generations

programme.desc: Picard and his crew face a Borg offensive as they try to ensure that a 21st-century scientist keeps a date with destiny.
programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact

programme.desc: A Federation mission to the planet Ba'ku takes a dangerous turn when a malfunctioning android, Data, takes a cultural task force hostage. When Capt. Picard and his crew investigate, they uncover the truth about the Federation mission: It was actually a systematic ploy by the Son'a to displace the peaceful inhabitants of Ba'ku. Now Picard and his crew must thwart the plot even while experiencing strange side effects from exposure to the planet's surface.

When the US president is captured and held hostage by a ruthless gang, only one-eyed mercenary Snake Plissken is considered capable of effecting a rescue. If he fails, he is programmed to self-destruct.

When they reach the Kansas farmhouse of an all-American family, the humans do everything they can to fend off the critters, but they cannot free themselves of the ferocious outsiders.

Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.

programme.desc: Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles

programme.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.
programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil

programme.desc: An alcoholic millionaire is threatened with losing his inheritance if he does not marry the girl of his parents' choosing. Despite his dislike for his prospective bride, he bows to the inevitable only to meet a light-fingered waitress who steals his heart. John Gielgud won an Oscar for his role as Arthur's loyal but outspoken valet.
programme.title: Arthur

programme.desc: A thirtysomething slacker attempts to inject some stability into his life by adopting an impressionable five-year-old.
programme.title: Big Daddy

programme.desc: When one-time rock hopeful Robbie is jilted at the altar, he vents his bitterness in song, even when singing at other people's weddings. Only true love can redeem the broken-hearted songster but fortunately, he's about to meet a woman who will spin him right round (like a record).
programme.title: The Wedding Singer

programme.desc: Danny Noonan, a teen down on his luck, works as a caddy at the snob-infested Bushwood Country Club to raise money for his college education. In an attempt to gain votes for a college scholarship reserved for caddies, Noonan volunteers to caddy for a prominent and influential club member. Meanwhile, Danny struggles to prepare for the high pressure Caddy Day golf tournament while absorbing New Age advice from wealthy golf guru Ty Webb.
programme.title: Caddyshack

programme.desc: Zany horror spoof about a brilliant brain surgeon who falls in love with a female brain stored in a jar. The brain is part of an impressive collection held by a colleague in Austria and, upon learning of his wife's infidelity, the surgeon allows himself to be charmed. Communicating telepathically with one of the specimens in the laboratory, he falls in love - but needs a body to put it in.
programme.title: The Man With Two Brains

Don and Lina have been cast repeatedly as a romantic couple, but when their latest film is remade into a musical, only Don has the voice for the new singing part. After a lot of practise with a diction coach, Lina still sounds terrible, and Kathy, a bright young aspiring actress, is hired to record over her voice.
programme.title: Singin' in the Rain

programme.desc: An unconventional sleuth attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.
programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective

programme.desc: Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.

programme.desc: A pair of idiotic friends set off on a madcap journey to return a briefcase to its owner. However, they are blissfully unaware that the case contains a large amount of ransom money for the owner's kidnapped husband. Their trip is soon fraught with disaster, especially when the kidnappers begin to pursue them across the country with the aim of grabbing the cash.
programme.title: Dumb & Dumber

programme.desc: A normally well-behaved teenager goes wild while his parents are out of town. He takes her in, and, following his school's entrepreneurial teachings, lets her turn the house into a brothel.

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Hour

programme.desc: S13 E1 — Lennie James, Sherdian Smith, Vanessa Williams Stephen Mangan presents as nine artists have four hours to paint Vanessa Williams, Sheridan Smith or Lennie James.
programme.title: Portrait Artist of the Year

programme.desc: Highlights of a concert recorded in Rome by the Italian tenor include some inspiring documentary material.
programme.title: Andrea Bocelli: Sacred Arias

programme.desc: Behind-the-scenes documentary shedding new light on the exciting and turbulent private lives of Stan Laurel and Oliver Hardy and the genuine friendship between them.
programme.title: Laurel & Hardy: Their Lives And Magic

programme.desc: A spellbinding collection of performances by unassuming and charismatic star Dean Martin, including That's Amore, Would I Love You and Memories Are Made Of This.
programme.title: Legends In Concert: Dean Martin

programme.desc: Choreographed by Michael Flatley of 'Riverdance' fame, 40 of the world's most talented performers combine traditional and contemporary music and dance in an exciting new adventure in London.
programme.title: Michael Flatley Lord of the Dance: Dangerous Games

programme.desc: S2 E4 — Bob Marley & the Wailers: Catch a Fire We have a look at Bob Marley and The Wailers' classic album, 'Catch A Fire'. With interviews with all the key players, we build a picture of how the album was conceived, produced and recorded.
programme.title: Classic Albums

programme.desc: Concert footage from 13 June 1980 features Bob Marley and his band performing their hits in Dortmund, Germany. Songs include `Natural Mystic', `I Shot the Sheriff', `No Woman, No Cry', `Exodus' and `Could You Be Loved'.
programme.title: Bob Marley Uprising Live!

programme.desc: Charting the life and death of the influential Four Aces Club venue based in Hackney, which showcased new music genres from Ska, Reggae, Soul to Acid House. It was London's equivalent of the New York Apollo.
programme.title: Legacy In The Dust: The Four Aces Story

programme.desc: E15 — Episode 15 Concerts from the Grand Ole Opry for country music fans.
programme.title: Opry Live

programme.desc: The captivating story of Luther Vandross, from his early Sesame Street appearances to becoming the indisputable master of the love song. Using rare archives, Vandross shares his own story with insights from his closest collaborators.
programme.title: Luther: Never Too Much

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Success The hard-won success of their predecessors enables stars like Shania Twain, Macy Gray, and Sarah McLachlan to overcome obstacles and reach new heights. Plus, a glimpse of a new generation featuring Taylor Swift, St Vincent, Billie Eilish, and more.
programme.title: Women Who Rock

programme.desc: The story behind the writing, recording, and success of Black Sabbath's legendary second studio album 'Paranoid', which featured the hit songs 'War Pigs', 'Iron Man', and the title track.
programme.title: Black Sabbath: Paranoid (Classic Album)

programme.desc: Jonas Kaufmann performs opera masterpieces at the iconic Arena di Verona.
programme.title: Jonas Kaufmann at Arena Di Verona

programme.desc: S1 E11 — Loosening Up Sara Reeve invites us into her creative world with a fresh and looser approach to portrait painting. In this demonstration, she embraces the challenge of using only a decorator's brush for the entire process, showcasing her unique style.
programme.title: Artist of the Year: Masterclass

programme.desc: S1 E12 — Observing Facial Features Gareth Reid demonstrates how to achieve a likeness when drawing a portrait. He does this through observing the facial features of a subject and breaking them down into interlocking shapes on the canvas.
programme.title: Artist of the Year: Masterclass

programme.desc: S7 E13 — The Reconciliation James Howgill finds his marriage to Caroline unfulfilling and wants a divorce, but she sees nothing wrong and refuses. In turn, he hires fastidious private eye HAK Bates in the hopes that he can catch her out with another man.
programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.desc: S7 E14 — The Mugger Government minister Gerald Overton goes to a party without his wife Jennifer, where he holds forth on his views on law and order. After being sidetracked by the seductive Mary Tregallas, he walks home and is barged into by a man in a park.
programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.desc: S2 E27 — I Killed the Count Inspector Davidson continues to investigate the murder of Count Mattoni, receiving yet another confession and encountering an unexpected obstacle to bringing the killer to justice.
programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents

programme.desc: S2 E28 — One More Mile to Go A man in a race against time to dispose of his wife's body, hidden in the boot of his car, finds himself menaced by an overly friendly motorcycle cop who nags him about a brake light.
programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents

programme.desc: S11 E12 — Sissy Spacek A look at the life of the Academy Award-winning actress and Grammy-nominated singer Sissy Spacek, who has had leading roles in movies such as 'Carrie', 'Crimes of the Heart', and 'Coal Miner's Daughter'.
programme.title: Discovering Film

programme.desc: S11 E4 — Gil Scott Heron: Pieces of a Man A look at what made 'Pieces of a Man' by the highly influential American soul and jazz musician Gil Scott-Heron so unique and inspiring when he released his debut album in 1971.
programme.title: Classic Albums

programme.desc: S7 E15 — Open Window Holidaying in Connecticut, Gregory visits an isolated hunting lodge and meets a girl called Jane, who tells him a disturbing story about an accident which befell members of her family when they went on a hunting expedition.
programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.desc: S8 E1 — People Don't Do Such Things Terence and Gwen Carter are a conventional married couple and they both disapprove of the womanising ways of Reeve Baker, Terence's friend and tax accountant. Terence is shocked, then, when Gwen tells him that she and Reeve are in love.
programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.desc: S2 E29 — Vicious Circle When his girlfriend threatens to go to the police, a hired hitman reluctantly sets out to kill her after being ordered by his crime boss, knowing he will not accept any failures.
programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents

programme.desc: S2 E30 — The Three Dreams of Mr. Findlater A man (John Williams) begins to have dreams about his wife's (Isobel Elsom) murder. With Barbara Baxley.
programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents

programme.desc: S3 E2 — Stone Carvers Simon Smith gives a stone-carving masterclass to three novices, while Bill visits Salisbury Cathedral, home to Britain's tallest stone spire.
programme.title: Bill Bailey's Master Crafters: The Next Generation

programme.desc: S11 E13 — Alan Rickman A look into the life and career of the British actor, known for his portrayal of villains in films like 'Die Hard' and 'Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves', as well as Severus Snape in the 'Harry Potter' franchise.
programme.title: Discovering Film

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Waddesdon Manor Frank Skinner and Joan Bakewell welcome a new group of artists to Waddesdon Manor in Buckinghamshire, where they have six hours to paint the stunning pareterre.
programme.title: Landscape Artist of the Year

programme.desc: S8 E2 — In the Cards Fortune-teller Madame Myra meets a man she foretells will come into a lot of money before dying shortly after. Although she does not find him attractive, she marries him in the hopes of becoming a wealthy widow.
programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.desc: S8 E3 — Nothin' Short of Highway Robbery On a long drive through the desert, a couple get their car serviced and are handed an extortionate bill. However, the tables are about to be turned because the couple were on a journey to do something highly illegal, and they have come prepared.
programme.title: Tales of the Unexpected

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Captive Audience A writer (James Mason) tries to convince his publisher that a plot is feasible. With Angie Dickinson.
programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Hour

programme.desc: Documents Luciano Pavarotti's emotional return to a small festival in North Wales.
programme.title: Pavarotti: The Lost Concert

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Maastricht: My Hometown In the wake of an iconic performance in André's hometown, take a look around the idyllic Maastricht and discover what the maestro's fame has done for the city, featuring interviews with shop owners, locals, and the mayor.
programme.title: André Rieu: Welcome to My World

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Vienna Memories André Rieu waltzes around Vienna, looking back at his most memorable concerts in the city of music, which include a magical performance in front of Schoenbrunn Palace.

Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael shows us how to make an impossibly delicious brunch menu of Parm Frittata with tomato sauce, served with a side of sausage and a simple salad that you can serve all day.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Asian chef Kinsan and Laura make Japanese Vegetable Tempura in the Market Kitchen. Laura then prepares Chicken Schnitzel with Mushroom Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Come spring, Lidia gets very excited to visit the market. The colour, the aromas, that first harvest, it all ignites her creative side to get cooking after a long winter.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Hayden dives at sunrise for sea urchins, then he's off to a local farmers' market to buy mushrooms, grab some famous donuts, and cook for his friends on their goat farm.

programme.title: Freshly Picked With Simon Toohey
programme.desc: Hot and spicy is all the rage in today's episode. Rebecca Veale is back in the kitchen for crispy chilli stir fry, and Simon brings a spicy salad loaded with mouthwatering roasted radishes.

programme.title: Jamie's Great Italian Escape
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver arrives on the tiny Sicilian island of Marettimo. Here he meets fisherman Giovanni - the owner of one of Sicily's best restaurants - who has Jamie work as his assistant in his eatery.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's a beautifully buttery night on The Cook Up, as Adam is joined by croissant connoisseur Kate Reid and acclaimed chef Giovanni Pilu.

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: This traditional Tuscan dish is perfect for a summer's late lunch to carry you into an evening of relaxing. Michael Symon revamps some grilled chicken by glazing it with some floral vermouth.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
programme.desc: Paula shows us how to make her version of steak diane by substituting the steak with a collop of venision which she roasts and serves with sauteed potatoes. She demonstrates how to smoke a chicken.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Vietnam
programme.desc: Chef Luke Nguyen visits the beachside town of Nha Trang, a coastal town abundant with fresh seafood - and prepares char grilled lobster right on the beach.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke heads to a coastal town to teach cooking skills to disabled children, who learn how to prepare fish cakes; Luke visits to a farmyard to learn how a family creates fresh tofu; local monks demonstrate how to cook a vegetarian meal.

programme.title: Planet Bbq
